payout_value_note: $50 per qualified referral; no stated cap on number of referrals
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($50-$50 per referral); time: referral share est. 5-15 min active
steps: Friend opens a new RCB personal checking account and names the referrer at account opening. Both parties must be current RCB customers with a personal checking account in good standing. Friend's account must stay in good standing with a $50 minimum balance for 30 days.
catches: Both referring and referred customer must be current RCB customers with a personal checking account open, active, and in good standing (positive balance, not being closed). Friend must be primary owner of a new RCB personal checking account (On-the-Go, Green-On-The-Go, Value, Green Online, Value Now, Honest Checking; Student Checking excluded), identify the referrer at account opening, maintain $50 minimum balance for 30 days, and not have had an RCB personal checking account within the prior 24 months. RCB employees/interns and their households excluded. Offer cannot be combined with other offers; void where prohibited; can be withdrawn or canceled at any time.

when_cash_arrives: Referral reward deposited to the referrer's RCB account within 45 days after the friend opens a new account that remains in good standing (minimum $50 balance for 30 days). Roughly a month from the trigger event to cash in hand.
maximize: Trigger the clock early: have your friend complete qualifying activity (direct deposit, debit transactions) in the first days of the window.
Route a real payroll direct deposit (not Zelle/P2P transfers, which most programs exclude) as early as possible - payroll timing is usually the gating step.
If any-amount direct deposit qualifies, a small recurring ACH can trigger it - check the program's 'qualifying deposit' definition first.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the payout window itself is 3-4 weeks after qualification - there is no expedited track.
